verdict.rationale: v0 documents a platform API that gives programmatic access to chat/code generation, project management, and deployment (v0-docs-4), and the official v0-sdk on GitHub shows concrete code for creating chats and streaming results with API-key auth (v0-gh-1, v0-gh-2, v0-gh-3), directly matching the 'generate and manage apps programmatically' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the API in production use and more detail on full app lifecycle management (list/delete/update) via the API beyond chat creation.
